items.text: kal kar do
shaam ko theek hai
subah jaldi bhejo
shaam 6 baje chalega
haan kal raat ko

items.context: Kya aap delivery schedule badalna chahenge?
items.text: abhi nahi bhai
mera parcel kal ki jagah aaj bhej do please
kya delivery time ko 3 baje se 5 baje kar sakte ho
main office pe nahi hoon aaj to delivery kal ho jayegi
delivery ka time thoda badha ke shaam 7 baje kar do
mera address same rahega par date change karni hai
kya aaj delivery ho sakti hai thoda jaldi se
agar possible ho to kal subah delivery bhej do

items.context: Aapko kis date ko delivery chahiye?
items.text: kal ki jagah aaj delivery karni hai

items.context: Kya aap address confirm kar denge delivery ke liye?
items.text: main ghar pe nahi hoon isliye schedule change karna hai

items.context: Kis time pe aapko delivery chahiye?
items.text: delivery ka samay badal ke shaam 6 baje kar dijiye

items.context: Kya aap weekend ke liye delivery reschedule karna chahenge?
items.text: mujhe weekend pe delivery chahiye isliye date shift karni hai

items.context: Delivery time mein koi badlav chahte hain?
items.text: subah 9 baje ke bad hi delivery bhejna
mera parcel kal ka cancel karke usko is hafte ke friday ko deliver karwana hai please
main Mumbai se hoon aur mujhe apna order thoda late yani 3 din baad chahiye
agar aaj aap delivery nahi kar sakte to please kal subah mere ghar par bhej dena

items.context: Kya aap delivery date reschedule karna chahenge?
items.text: agar main delivery date badalna chahun to kya mujhe alag se charges dene padenge

items.context: Kya aap delivery ke time mein koi change karna chahenge?
items.text: mera delivery address to wahi rahega magar delivery ka time thoda aage badhwana hai
kya aap mujhe batayenge ki mera parcel kab deliver hoga abhi ki delivery date thodi change karni hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: reschedule - wants the delivery on a different day or time
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
